notes.title: Update R2! Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

We have just released our release 2 update (R2)!

[h1]Fixes:    [/h1]

-The left hand side lifeboats now move further away from the ship. This stops the ship from clipping into some of them them while sinking

-Fixed the lifeboat that glitched in the daytime explore mode

-Fixed the water clipping through one of the lifeboats

Please leave a review if you are enjoying the game!

[h1]Interactive Gaming Studios    [/h1]

notes.title: Update R1! Fixes and more!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

We have just uploaded our release 1 update (R1)!

[h1]Fixes:    [/h1]

-The water now does not clip through the lifeboats

[h1]Additions:    [/h1]

-We added a daytime explore mode

-We added a sound effect when the lights go out

-We updated the menu instructions for the free camera mode. To use the pause menu you have to firstly lock the cursor by pressing the right mouse button before entering the menu

If you are enjoying the game please leave a review!

[h1]Interactive Gaming Studios    [/h1]
